source.note: Stands in for plan row #128 (Quaternius sushi/food truck, poly.pizza only, blocked by its Cloudflare challenge). Ouren's 'Chinese Food Cart' on OpenGameArt, CC-BY 3.0 (the page's only licence; copyright/attribution notice: Wolfgang Wozniak). One old Blender Internal .blend (opened with auto-run off) with three painted atlases; its images point at .jpg files the zip ships as .png, relinked by stem. The faces sample one atlas (`legacyImage` Map #1.001, the cart atlas: green slats, grey metal, white panels) and each material's colours are clustered (maxColors 10). The page's 'animated preview' is a turntable GIF; the .blend has no actions, so the entry is static. Recoloured on noon toward a Japanese yatai: tiled pagoda roof and eave horns red over dark-wood shade (every roof cluster, since the roof material's own atlas is not the one sampled), the source's green slatted body dark wood (one tone both sides, as door-shoji and wall-shoji), white metal panels, stove top and chimney practical white over paper shade, the stove hole and grille slots near-black, wheels near-black over dark wood. Honest read: a red-roofed wooden pushcart with a serving window; the chimney, stove box and upturned pagoda eaves keep it closer to a Chinese street cart than a Japanese yatai (no noren curtain or lanterns). Size: 2.4 m to the chimney cap, 2.3 m long, 1.13 m deep. The serving window faces +Z.
source.changes: replaced the painted textures with flat colours (cart atlas sampled per face, clustered); recoloured to the noon script; rescaled to 2.4 m, recentred; meshopt-compressed GLB
